summary: Baozun Inc. filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on April 23, 2026, announcing the filing of its annual report on Form 20-F for fiscal year 2025 and the release of its 2025 Annual Sustainability Report. The filing is a routine regulatory disclosure by a foreign private issuer, providing access to its annual financial results and sustainability achievements. No special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or management change is involved. The company, a brand e-commerce solution provider, continues its normal reporting obligations without any transformative event or strategic action.
